subject: Retail live-shopping: degraded streaming latency during sale — mitigation & follow-up
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@fastretail.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: fastretail-ops@fastretail.com
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Live shopping sessions slowing — urgent

Hi Evelyn,

We started seeing significant delays in the live-shopping chat stream this afternoon during our flash sale window. Customers report long pauses between bot replies and the UI shows partial chunking for several customers (approx 4–7s gaps). This is happening across our US region and is affecting checkout conversions.

Attached a short screen capture and the client-side trace. Please advise immediate mitigations — we have marketing promos running for the next 90 minutes.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Customer Ops, FastRetail

Attachments: screenshot_latency.png (image/png), chat_trace_client.json (referenced)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@fastretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 15:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Live shopping sessions slowing — urgent

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the traces. We're actively triaging. Quick notes and immediate actions we can take now: 

- Temporary config change: We'll lower the max batch window for your streaming route to prioritize latency over throughput (applies in ~2 min).
- Prefix/KV cache: We'll pin the hot conversation contexts in edge caches for the next 2 hours to avoid cold KV-hits.
- Fallback variant: We'll enable the lightweight model variant (quantized) for newly created sessions to reduce token processing time.

Ben and Karthik are on the incident. Ben, please coordinate the config push and confirm once live. Karthik, start a focused trace on the US edge shards and check for CPU/IO saturation.

We'll keep this on a short bridge and follow up with a post-incident summary.

Evelyn
Senior Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference

--

Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 15:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Live shopping sessions slowing — urgent

Status update: config changes applied at 15:34 PDT.

What we did (actioned within Redwood control plane):
- Reduced streaming route batch window from 80ms -> 30ms for account FastRetail (route: /v1/chat/stream/fastretail).
- Enabled lightweight quantized variant v1.3-q for new sessions (fall back for older sessions).
- Increased prefix cache TTL and pinned top-50 conversation keys to edge nodes serving us-east-1.

Preliminary results: median token-to-client time improved from ~210ms/token to ~95ms/token for new sessions; existing sessions still showing partial recovery (~180ms/token). We're continuing to drain queued KV load on shard us-east-1b.

Karthik — your traces? If we need a shard failover we'll coordinate now.

Attachments: chat_trace_20270729.log (server-side), timeline_notes.pdf

Ben
Incident Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Post-incident summary & next steps — FastRetail live-shopping latency

Hi all — closing the loop with a concise post-incident summary and recommended follow-ups. This is written for both FastRetail ops and our internal teams.

What happened (summary):
- On 2027-07-29 14:58 PDT we observed a surge in long-tail session KV misses tied to a customer-wide templated prompt pattern used by FastRetail during the flash-sale. The pattern caused disproportionate KV growth (cache thrash) on the us-east-1b edge shard which led to increased KV fetch latency and elevated token emission gaps.

Immediate mitigations (what we did):
- Rapid config change to reduce batch window and favor lower latency (applied within 2 min).
- Edge prefix pinning and TTL increase for high-frequency conversation keys.
- Temporary route-level model fallback to quantized variant for new sessions.
- Increased autoscale headroom on affected edge pool and monitored drop in queue depth.

Impact:
- Public-facing customer chat streams experienced intermittent 3–8s pauses during the peak minute (estimated 12% of active sessions impacted). No data leakage or authorization issues were observed.

Action items (owners & timeline):
- Engineering: Implement a prompt-shape detector to circuit-break KV growth for templated high-variability prompts (owner: Karthik) — ETA 3 weeks.
- Product: Add route-level safe defaults for batch windows and a one-click latency-first toggle for customers (owner: Laura) — ETA 6 weeks.
- Customer Success: Provide FastRetail with a short playbook to avoid specific templated prompts during flash windows (owner: Evelyn) — ETA 48 hours.
- Support: Offer a goodwill credit for the impacted sale window (owner: Laura + Finance) — ETA decision by 2027-08-03.

Follow-up links and artifacts:
- Full server-side trace: https://drive.redwood/team-postmortems/FastRetail-20270730-postmortem
- Telemetry snapshot (15:30–16:10 PDT): HubSpot: HS-48912

If FastRetail requests a deeper technical walk-through we'll schedule a 45-minute run-through with infra + product next week. Elena — please let us know preferred times.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
